answer: Miscellaneous >> Dua (Supplications) Question ID: 57204 Country: India Title: Hair fall problem Question: I had hair fall problem immensely from quite long time. Now I am 26 years old and half of my hair fallen. Please give duas/wazifah to re-grow my fallen hair and control left over hair. Answer ID: 57204 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 292/289/B=04/1436) Recite the following dua seven times daily, with the firm belief of healing. It is hoped that Allah shall heal you. أَسْأَلُ اللّهَ الْعَظِيمَ رَبَّ الْعَرْشِ العَظِيمِ أَنْ يَشْفِيَنِيْ. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
